info.name: InDebted Receive API Documentation Account Event API
Get events by event type and timeframe. Paginated.

params.name: clientId
params.description:
A Receive system identifier that will be assigned automatically.
It will be used for situations like Support related interventions or data segmentation.

params.name: eventType
params.description: type of event that happened in Receive system

params.name: date
params.description: date which to get the events for

params.name: limit
params.description: amount of events per page, default is 1000

params.name: page
params.description: number of page to retrieve the events for, default is 1
